title: Morrice
html_source:
Morrice
n. Same as 1st Morris.
a. Dancing the morrice; dancing.

mor·ris (môr′ĭs, mŏr′-) n.
An English folk dance in which a story is enacted by costumed dancers.

The dance was ‘moorish’. ‘Mummers’ and ‘moorish’ return in Scylla and Charybdis.
